question: Who among the following is NOT a shehnai player?
solution:
The correct answer is __**N Ramani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **N Ramani** was a renowned **flautist** and not a shehnai player.
 
• He was known for his exceptional skills in playing the **south Indian Carnatic flute**.
 
• Ramani was born in **1934** and was a disciple of the legendary **flute maestro T. R. Mahalingam**.
 
• He received numerous awards and accolades, including the **Padma Shri** and the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Krishna Ram Chaudhary**:

 
 
• He is a renowned shehnai player from India.
 
• He has contributed significantly to the field of classical music with his shehnai recitals.
 
 
 
• **Ali Ahmad Hussain**:
 
 
• He was a distinguished shehnai player from Kolkata.
 
• He was known for his unique style and contribution to Indian classical music.
 
 
 
• **Bismillah Khan**:
 
 
• He was one of the most famous shehnai players in India.
 
• Bismillah Khan was awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award.
 
• He popularized the shehnai and brought it to the center stage of Indian classical music.
